verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results API. A product of this type could plausibly offer saved or scheduled search jobs, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no automation object that can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The Searches Archive and the 1-hour result cache store past search results, not versioned automation definitions, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
